page.title: Evaluation cycle
page.description: The fiscal year runs from April to March. HR opens the cycle and its stages move by their dates.
page.loadFailed: The evaluation cycle could not be loaded.
page.notReady: The cycle cannot open before the evaluation file is uploaded: the template of each of the five stages, the grade scale and the fiscal-year card.

actions.open: Open the evaluation cycle and notify employees
actions.advance: Move the cycle to the next stage
actions.failed: The action failed: the stage of the cycle may have changed. Reload the page.

blocked.closeNotOpen: The cycle has not been opened yet.

self.title: Self-evaluation
self.what: Rates their behaviours, writes their achievements and picks from the catalog of initiatives; their manager is notified when they send it.

mgr.title: Manager's evaluation
mgr.who: The direct manager, then the upper manager
mgr.what: Reviews the self-evaluation and enters the results and behaviour scores; evaluating indirect reports follows their direct manager's review.

cal.title: Calibration
cal.who: The holder of the calibration key
cal.what: Compares scores between managers and adjusts with a written reason.

appr.title: Approval
appr.who: The holder of the approval key
appr.what: Approves the results and decides on objections.

notif.title: Individual notification
notif.what: Tells each employee their result individually, with an exportable copy.

obj.title: Objection window
obj.who: The employee and the approval holder
obj.what: One reasoned objection on one item; the approver accepts it and returns it to the manager, or rejects it with a reason.

closed.title: Closed
closed.what: The cycle is closed and the results stay in the employee's record.

stage.goSoon: This stage's screen is built in a later delivery.

readiness.title: Readiness to open the cycle
readiness.snapshot: The cycle takes a snapshot of each stage's template when it opens, so a past year's evaluation does not change if the file changes later.

open.title: Open the evaluation cycle
open.description: The cycle opens for a fiscal year and starts at the self-evaluation stage.
open.yearInvalid: Enter a year of four digits.
open.snapshot: The cycle takes a snapshot of the templates when it opens: what is uploaded afterwards does not change this year.
open.yearExists: A cycle for this year exists already.
open.failed: The cycle could not be opened.

advance.title: Move the cycle to the next stage
advance.description: The cycle moves to the next stage and does not go back.
advance.done: The cycle moved to the next stage.

closeCycle.title: Confirm
closeCycle.description: Close the cycle for good? The evaluations cannot change after that, and the results stay in each employee's record.
closeCycle.done: The cycle was closed and your name and the time were saved.

dates.title: Stage dates
dates.note: The change is recorded in the audit log and the people whose dates are affected are notified.
dates.failed: The date could not be saved.

keys.final: Final result after the numbers close
keys.notification: Individual notification with an exportable copy
keys.objection: Objection window (five working days from the notification)
keys.qualitative_close: Close of the qualitative part (behaviour and evidence)

problems.end_before_start: The end date is before the start.
problems.before_previous: The date is before the end of the stage ahead of it ({{date}}).
problems.after_next: The date runs past the start of the stage behind it ({{date}}).
problems.unknown: The date does not fit the other dates.

catalog.title: This year's extra-component catalog
catalog.empty: The catalog has no items yet.
catalog.noMatches: No item matches the search and filters.
catalog.added: The item was added to the catalog.
catalog.removeTitle: Delete an item from the catalog
catalog.failed: The item could not be added.
catalog.removeFailed: The item could not be deleted.
catalog.addTitle: Add an item to the catalog
catalog.invalid: Write the item name (3 characters) and points from 1 to 10.
catalog.caps: Internal initiatives are capped at {{init}} and contribution to growth at {{growth}}. Learning comes automatically from the learning plan.

file.title: Upload the performance evaluation file (all stages)
file.description: One file holds the five stages, then the grade scale and the fiscal-year card. Nothing is saved before you review it.
file.hint: txt, docx or pdf, read in the browser
file.checkFailed: The file could not be checked.
file.empty: The text holds no stage, grade scale or fiscal card.
file.save: Save the evaluation of all stages
file.saved: The evaluation of {{count}} stages was saved and now shows in the files of the title holders.
file.saveRefused: The file has parts that need review and was not saved.
file.saveFailed: The file could not be saved.

readErrors.unsupported: The file type is not supported.
readErrors.unreadable: The file could not be read.

problems.basic_split: Results + behaviour do not make the basic total.
problems.criteria_sum: The shares of the results criteria do not add up to 100.
problems.cap_sum: Basic + extra do not make the cap.
problems.behaviour_question: A behaviour has no question for the evaluator.
problems.duplicate_stage: The stage appears twice in the file.
problems.scale_levels: The grade scale has from two to ten levels.
problems.scale_range: A range of the grade scale is not understood.
problems.fiscal_months: The fiscal-year card does not have twelve months.
problems.stage_range: The stage number is outside 1 to 5.
problems.behaviour_code: A behaviour code is wrong or repeated (the form is B1.1).

file.pastePlaceholder: Paste the text of the evaluation file
file.saveOff: Saving is enabled after a sound file is extracted with all its stages, its scale and its card.
file.shared: Shared by the stages: a grade scale of {{scale}} levels, and a fiscal-year card of {{months}} months and {{notes}} notes.
file.fewStages: Only {{count}} of 5 stages were found. The missing stages stay «not uploaded».
file.weightsNote: An evaluation whose weights do not add up as expected is not saved.

ai.running: The AI is reading the file… it may take a minute or two.
ai.notice: The text of the file is sent to the AI service switched on in the settings. It is company data, not employee data.
ai.offer: The AI can read the file in any order and put each part in its place; you review the result before anything is saved.
ai.badge: Arranged by the AI: review it before saving
ai.ungroundedTitle: These texts are not in the file word for word, check them before saving:

errors.AI_UNAVAILABLE: The AI service did not give a valid answer. Try again.
errors.EVAL_FILE_AI_RATE_LIMITED: Too many files were sent to the AI. Try again later.
errors.generic: The file could not be analysed.

performance-cycle.title: Evaluation cycle
performance-cycle.body: HR opens the performance evaluation cycle here, moves it through its stages and closes it, uploads the evaluation file and sets the dates and the catalog.

none.title: The evaluation cycle is open: rate yourself
none.body: Last day: {{date}}. You rate your behaviours and write your achievements, then your direct manager is told.

draft.title: You have a draft that was not sent

sent.title: You sent your self-evaluation
sent.body: Your manager {{manager}} was told and reviews it, then it goes to the manager above. You can change it until your manager starts.

self.noScores: Scores are not shown before the individual notification after the approval.
self.managerStage: The manager's stage: you can change your evaluation until your manager starts.

reminders.title: Automatic reminders
reminders.note: Reminders arrive as an in-app notice and an e-mail, and stop once the work is done. They are not sent at the weekend.
reminders.failed: The reminder could not be saved.
reminders.removeFailed: The reminder could not be deleted.
reminders.noMatches: No reminder matches the search and filters.
reminders.dialogDescription: An automatic reminder by in-app notice and e-mail; it stops once the work is done and is not sent at the weekend.

kinds.mgr: Manager: an evaluation waiting for them

fields.selfDays: Days before the last day (comma separated) *
fields.englishHint: Optional: when empty, the Arabic title and text are sent.

invalid.self: The employee's days are from 1 to 30 (up to 10 days), separated by commas.

templates.title: Evaluation file
templates.noMatches: No part matches the search and filters.
templates.note: A change to the evaluation file applies to the next cycles; the cycle in progress keeps its snapshot.
templates.removeTitle: Delete the template of a stage
templates.removeDescription: «{{name}}» becomes not uploaded, and no new cycle opens until it is uploaded again. The cycle in progress is not affected.
templates.removeFailed: The stage template could not be deleted.

editor.saveFailed: It could not be saved. Check the fields and try again.
editor.complete: Fill the required fields: the names, the numbers of the weights, points and shares, and the question of every behaviour.

stage.title: Template of stage {{stage}} {{name}}
stage.description: The weights, the extra components, the results criteria and the behaviours. The basic total and the cap follow from the weights and points.
stage.name: Name of the stage
stage.cap: Cap = basic + points of the extra components = {{cap}}
stage.resultsNote: What the results mean in this stage
stage.question: The evaluator's question

scale.title: Grade scale
scale.description: Two to ten levels from the highest to the lowest: the highest has no «to» and the lowest no «from». A new level is added at the bottom.
scale.hint: Write the limits of each level; the text of the ranges shows here once they are right.
scale.name: Name of the level
scale.rangeProblem: The ranges must follow one another from the highest to the lowest without overlapping.

fiscal.title: Fiscal-year card
fiscal.description: Twelve months from April to March: each is a milestone or a month of daily follow-up.
